hooks.name: Prisma schema change reminder
hooks.description: When the Prisma schema file is modified, remind to regenerate the Prisma client and run migrations

action.prompt: The Prisma schema has been modified. Remember to: 1) Run `pnpm --filter @taskflow/api prisma generate` to regenerate the Prisma client. 2) Run `pnpm --filter @taskflow/api prisma migrate dev --name <description>` to create a new migration. 3) Verify that the shared Zod schemas in `packages/shared/src/schemas/` still match the updated Prisma models. 4) Update the seed script if new fields were added.
